headerDisplay: Controls WiFi-connected Coway Airmega purifiers through the IoCare cloud. Coway offers no local API, so an IoCare account is required.
footerDisplay: Accounts that sign in with Google or Apple cannot be used — the plugin needs an email/password login.

skipPasswordChange.title: Defer Coway's 60-day password change
skipPasswordChange.description: Coway asks for a new password every 60 days and blocks sign-in until it is changed. When on, the plugin answers "change next time", as the IoCare app lets you do. Turn off to have the plugin stop and report it instead.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to read state from Coway. Each poll is several cloud requests; below 30s is rejected.

exposeLight.title: Expose the panel light as a bulb
exposeLight.description: Panel light. The plugin picks the right on/off encoding for known models, and auto-detects it on others once it sees a distinguishing value.

exposeModeSwitches.title: Expose Night / Rapid / Eco modes as switches
exposeModeSwitches.description: HomeKit's air purifier has only Auto and Manual. Night (Sleep) is already the speed slider's lowest step; these switches give each mode a name in Home and an automation trigger, and reach Rapid and Eco. Only the modes your model supports are shown: Night on most models, Rapid on the 250S, Eco on the AP-1512HHS. Unrecognised models get all three.

lightConvention.title: Light Convention
lightConvention.description: Only relevant when the panel light is exposed. Leave on Automatic unless the light behaves backwards.
